paper_title: Bounds on heavy axions with an X-ray free electron laser
notes: New exclusion bounds on axion-like particles (ALPs) obtained at the European X-ray Free Electron Laser (EuXFEL) facility using the Primakoff effect in Laue-case crystal geometry. Data extracted from Table I showing bounds at 5 discrete detuning angles (Δθ) corresponding to different axion masses. The experiment searches for axion production via photon decay in strong crystalline electric fields and subsequent regeneration after passing through an opaque wall. Bounds represent 90% CL upper limits on g_agamma based on zero observed events consistent with axion production. The mass range covered is approximately 10^-3 eV to 10^4 eV, with the discrete measurements shown spanning ~44 eV to ~2.4 keV. Figure 5 shows the full exclusion curve compared to previous laboratory searches (Yamaji et al., NOMAD, PVLAS, ALPS, NA64, BaBar, Battesti et al., Inada et al.). The paper notes this is not the best achievable sensitivity with the current setup due to X-ray heating issues, alignment stability limitations, and operational constraints that could be improved by a factor ~150 in future runs. | selector: table (sole candidate)
